pages.title: Wyrm Degree
pages.description: Allows Starbuncles to insert/extract items from a specific side with Direction Scrolls.

pages.title: Square Robin Mask
pages.description: Allows Starbuncles to round-robin items between inventories. While wearing the accessory, the Starbuncle will only pickup items from the ground. Each stacked starbuncle will carry maxStack/numDestInventories items, before moving to the next inventory.
